miniProject.title: Versioned reversal RL against sampling and filtered-SFT controls
miniProject.brief: Extend `lmlab` in `rl/` with a bounded synchronous reversal study from the existing small-decoder SFT initialization. Check objectives before live updates, preserve a weak-verifier ablation, and compare learned policies with frozen sampling and filtered SFT on your machine without paid APIs or a learned process reward model.
steps: Freeze reversal splits, character-tokenizer lineage, output grammar, action masks, terminal events and reward placement in `rl/`, linked to the SFT checkpoint. Check correct, wrong, malformed and truncated fixtures against an independent exact-answer evaluator; retain the task contract, parameter/FLOP budget and stop rules.

Before live training, check frozen-rollout REINFORCE, RLOO, GAE boundaries and signed clipping against exact enumeration, autodiff and CS336 Assignment 5 loss cases. Retain detached-baseline, ratio-direction and padding regressions, categorical KL/entropy checks and the full-vocabulary distillation gradient fixture; no critic training is required.

Implement explicit group centering, standard-deviation and loss-denominator choices, passing CS336 GRPO and Dr. GRPO component cases. Check unequal lengths, accumulation, all-correct/all-wrong groups and singleton rejection against independent reductions and gradients; retain the objective contract and isolate the planned live normalization change.

Build bounded synchronous collection, verification, update and held-out evaluation, passing CS336's on-policy train-step case first. Bind immutable rollouts to prompt, sampler, RNG, actor, old-policy, reference and verifier identities; inject old-score overwrite and lag failures, retain rejection evidence, and regenerate after each update.

Run matched normalization and strict-versus-substring reward ablations across seeds from the same initialization. Check planted exploits with independent verdicts; preserve the weak-reward run, parsing/format/correctness components, role-bound KL, entropy, diversity, length and signal-coverage traces, plus every invalid, filtered, timed-out and retried attempt.

Refit strict-correct outputs from a versioned starting-policy pool with response-only SFT and a matched random-per-prompt control where feasible. Check retained counts and empty groups against the pool; audit first-error positions against reversal targets and retain a segmentation-sensitive process-score fixture beside outcome verdicts.

Compare frozen SFT, RL and filtered-SFT checkpoints through the same `eval/` sampling curves: random, answer-vote, verifier selection and oracle coverage. Validate pass-at-k by subset enumeration; retain sample/token-matched views, paired and seed uncertainty, complete training/inference/verifier costs, failed runs and clean reproduction with bounded claims.
deliverables: The `rl/` task, immutable rollout collector and update path with frozen-rollout, role, freshness and verifier regressions.
Normalization and weak-reward ablations, filtered/random refit controls, first-error audit and teacher-signal fixture linked through `registry/`.
Reproducible sampling curves and resource ledger separating selected accuracy, oracle coverage, policy updates and verifier exploitation.

checks.name: CS336 Assignment 5: policy losses, normalization and on-policy update
checks.note: Pass loss, normalization, aggregation and train-step snapshots privately; independent gradient, collection, identity and verifier checks cover their missing guarantees.

rubric.pass: Independent enumeration and gradient tests validate masks, baselines, clipping, GAE, normalization, KL and teacher signal before updates; immutable role manifests reject overwritten old scores and stale-policy inputs.
rubric.strong: Tests distinguish scalar agreement from gradient agreement, inclusive centering from RLOO, old-policy drift from reference drift, and fixed-prefix distillation from full trajectory differentiation.

rubric.pass: Matched normalization and weak-reward runs retain component verdicts, exploits, role-bound traces and every failed attempt; independent reversal checks validate first-error positions and segmentation-sensitive scoring.
rubric.strong: The report distinguishes verifier loopholes, zero outcome signal, mastery, collapse and infrastructure errors without claiming a planted exploit was discovered by training.

rubric.pass: Frozen SFT, RL and filtered-SFT curves share an evaluator and matched budgets across seeds; enumeration validates coverage, and clean reproduction rebuilds uncertainty, retention counts, random-refit controls and complete costs.
rubric.strong: Negative and empty-pool regimes remain visible; claims separate changed sampling efficiency from new support, faithful reasoning or universal capacity, with residual prompt/token imbalances disclosed.

miniProject.feedsInto: Immutable rollouts, tested policy objectives, verifier exploits, process-audit fixtures and compute-matched sampling curves feed safety stress tests and the capstone's mechanism-isolating extension, independent evaluation and failure dossier.
